items.title: Mr. and Mrs. A.C. Synigal Interview, 1962-05-24
items.q: Ms. Bozamp, my secretary, and I, we fixed the roots of the parade.

ctx.x: Oh, they had to be top. Now, that's one thing I put my foot down on. They were fixing the roots of the parade. And so the Sergeant Aubrey, he had his men out there to tie the parade. And so, Ms. Bozamp, my secretary, and I, we fixed the roots of the parade. And I said, Ms. Senegal, I'll suit you. And I said, well, if you didn't like me, I said, all right, let's go over this thing again. All right. We took about, oh, from 8 to about 11 o'clock at night. We were going over that root, faced the bands and everything,…
And I had never heard about that.
